tribal_branches.name: Main Sardari Lineage (Larkana-Dadu)
tribal_branches.summary: Primary chieftaincy lineage presiding over tribal affairs, dispute resolution, and community cohesion across upper and central Sindh.

tribal_branches.name: Southern Punjab Branch (Jhang)
tribal_branches.summary: Northern riverine migration branch settled along the Chenab-Indus corridor.

historical_timeline.title: Eastward Baloch Dispersals from Highlands
historical_timeline.description: Movement of Baloch clans from Makran, Kalat, and the Sulaiman ranges into the Kachhi plains and Kirthar foothills.

historical_timeline.title: Consolidation of Agrarian Settlements in Upper Sindh
historical_timeline.description: Establishment of permanent villages, agrarian landholdings, and formal Sardari leadership across Larkana, Dadu, and Sukkur.

historical_timeline.title: Launch of Gadehi Baloch Global Heritage Archive
historical_timeline.description: Digital unification of Gadehi history, genealogy, and worldwide professional directory founded by Fayyaz Ali Gadehi.
